check: R-0031: observer read-only capture and orphan substitution rejection

read_only_mount_physical.claim: The exact candidate custody module exported and verified under a read-only source mount without creating or writing the live lock.

actual_reader.observation: After deleting the live source journal and restoring from the signed bundle at the accepted witness count/tip, the actual builder witness verifier returns (True, ''); a later lawful append also verifies without resetting the accepted commitment.

substitution_law.rule: An existing tip-named bundle without a manifest is completed only when its bytes equal the exact live prefix captured under the read-only lock.
substitution_law.false_behavior: A planted 2-record prefix of a 3-record live journal previously received a signed manifest.
substitution_law.new_behavior: The same attempt refuses with custody_bundle_substitution and does not publish a manifest.

limits: The container probe is component-level, not a shipped observer task or S3/EFS deployment.
The read-only probe uses the existing writer-created sidecar; production must retain that sidecar on the observer's read-only mount.
A missing sidecar on a non-empty read-only journal refuses rather than creating one.
